description: A self-hosted Excalidraw whiteboard for SiYuan. Hand-drawn canvas with offline fonts, SiYuan theme sync, and SVG export that embeds the editable scene.
工作空间内的 SVG 路径: Path to an SVG inside the workspace
新白板保存的位置（工作空间相对路径，默认 assets/excali）。白板库只: Where new whiteboards are saved (workspace-relative path, defaults to assets/excali). The board library only lists .svg files in this folder; the assets root is left for regular image attachments.
画笔颜色跟随思源强调色: Stroke color follows the SiYuan accent color
新画板把第一笔的默认颜色设成当前主题强调色；只影响默认值，不覆盖已有图。: New boards start with the current theme accent as the default ink color. Only affects the default value.
空画板显示引导画面: Show the welcome screen on an empty board
空白板中央显示手绘纸飞机和上手提示；落第一笔就消失，只影响新建的白板。: A hand-drawn paper plane and a few tips in the middle of an empty board. It vanishes on the first stroke, and only affects new boards.
正文里打 /白板，随时开一张新板: Type /whiteboard in the text to open a new board any time
右键文档里的手绘图，可以再打开继续画: Right-click a hand-drawn image in a document to reopen and keep drawing
这个 SVG 里没有可编辑的白板数据（不是本插件或 Excalidraw 导出的: This SVG has no editable whiteboard data (not exported by this plugin or Excalidraw)
这个 SVG 里内嵌的不是 Excalidraw 场景: The embedded data in this SVG is not an Excalidraw scene
这个白板用了暂不支持的格式：{detail}: This whiteboard uses an unsupported format: {detail}
插件已卸载，画板未保存的改动会丢失: The plugin was unloaded; unsaved canvas changes are lost
有未保存的改动，关闭后无法恢复。确定关闭？: There are unsaved changes that cannot be recovered after closing. Close anyway?
内嵌可编辑 scene（可用本插件再次打开）: Embed editable scene (reopenable in this plugin)
画板为空，无可导出的内容: Canvas is empty; nothing to export
目录里还没有白板文件: No whiteboard files in this folder yet
缩放并滚动到全部内容: Zoom to fit and scroll to all content
没有可运行脚本的白板：请先打开一张: No board to run scripts on: open one first
已复制图片引用：粘贴到思源正文即插入白板: Image reference copied: paste into the SiYuan editor to insert the board
白板还没保存，保存后才能复制引用: Board not saved yet — save it before copying a reference
将删除白板文件 {name} 及其备份（如存在）。删除不可恢复；白板开着时，画布: This deletes board file {name} and its backup (if any). Deletion is permanent; unsaved canvas changes are discarded too.
没有可删除的白板：当前没有打开已保存的白板: Nothing to delete: no saved board is open
透明背景（JPEG 不支持，将用白底）: Transparent background (JPEG has no transparency; white will be used)
在任意白板里切换网格都会记住这个值，之后所有白板（含还没保存过的空白板）打开时都: Toggling the grid on any board remembers the choice, and every board (including unsaved empty ones) opens with it. Changing this only affects tabs opened afterwards.
画几笔，文件自动跟着存: Draw a few strokes; the file saves itself as you go
☰ 菜单里能重命名、导出图片: The ☰ menu can rename and export images
这个画板还没有文件，无法重命名: This board has no file yet; cannot rename
白板迁移未完成：{fail} 块失败，下次启动会重试: Whiteboard migration incomplete: {fail} failed; will retry on next startup
荧光笔（已激活，再点换色）: Highlighter (on) — click again to change color
只改选中图形的边框色，文字颜色保持不变: Recolor only the outline of selected shapes; text color stays unchanged
只改边框颜色，文字颜色保持不变: Outline only — text color stays unchanged
请先选中要改外框的图形（文字颜色不会被改动）: Select the shapes whose outlines you want to recolor (text color is never changed)
先打开一块白板，再改外框颜色: Open a board first, then recolor its outlines
粘贴思源块链接或块 ID（siyuan://blocks/…）: Paste a block link or block ID (siyuan://blocks/…)
还没有脚本：首次启用会自动安装内置脚本到 {dir}: No scripts yet: built-in scripts are installed automatically to {dir} on first launch
列出白板库里的白板（标题、路径、更新时间），可按 query 过滤。只读。: List boards in the library (title, path, updated time), optionally filtered by query. Read-only.
打开指定白板并等待画布就绪；board 传标题，path 传保存目录下的路径。: Open a board and wait until the canvas is ready. Pass a title in board or a path under the save directory.
用 AI 计划绘制 Excali 白板: Draw an Excali board from an AI plan
把结构化计划（nodes/edges）画成白板：board 为空则新建，有值则追: Draw a structured plan (nodes/edges) onto a board: create a new board when board is empty, otherwise append to the existing one. Layout, style, and save automatically.
绘图计划：{ title, caption, preset, layout, g: Drawing plan: { title, caption, preset, layout, groups, nodes: [{id,label,shape,group,rank,order}], edges: [{from,to,label}] }
要画框的分组：{ 组名: 框标题 }，组名对应 node.group；同组节点在: Groups to frame: { groupName: frame title }, keyed by node.group; members of a group are kept together within a layer, and a warning is returned if a frame encloses a non-member
节点：字符串，或 {id,label,shape,group,rank,orde: Nodes: a string, or {id,label,shape,group,rank,order}. rank = pin to a layer in lr/tb (0-based); order = position within the layer, compared against positions (0 = first; a cell in grid, a slot on the ring in radial). All optional
追加到已有白板的标题或路径；省略则新建: Title or path of an existing board to append to; omit to create a new board
新建白板的文件名；省略用计划标题或「AI 白板」: File name for a new board; defaults to the plan title or "AI Board"
board 指向已有白板时是否追加，默认 true: Whether to append when board points to an existing board (default true)
覆盖计划内的风格: Override the preset in the plan
风格包名：内置预设，或 assets/excali-styles 目录里的 js: Style pack name: a built-in preset, or a json pack under assets/excali-styles; same meaning as preset, style wins
pencil/marker/blueprint 或 data/assets/ex: pencil/marker/blueprint, or a style pack name under data/assets/excali-styles
覆盖计划内的布局: Override the layout in the plan
生成图片并插入 Excali 白板: Generate an image into an Excali board
调用设置里的 OpenAI 兼容图像 API 生成一张位图，插入已有白板或新建白: Call the OpenAI-compatible image API configured in settings to generate a bitmap and insert it into an existing or new board; the image is not editable. Configure the API URL and key in plugin settings first.
画面描述（主体、风格、构图；上限 4000 字符）: Image description (subject, style, composition; max 4000 characters)
插入到已有白板的标题或路径；省略则新建: Title or path of an existing board to insert into; omit to create a new board
新白板文件名；省略用「AI 图片」: File name for the new board; defaults to "AI Image"
board 指向已有白板时是否插入到该板，默认 true: Whether to insert into the board when board points to an existing one (default true)
图像显示宽度；省略按原图尺寸: Display width of the image; defaults to its natural size
图像显示高度；省略按原图尺寸: Display height of the image; defaults to its natural size
尺寸覆盖（如 1024x1024）；省略用设置里的值: Size override (e.g. 1024x1024); defaults to the value in settings
OpenAI 兼容的 images API 地址（如 https://api.o: OpenAI-compatible images API URL (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1); leave empty to disable image generation.
模型名（如 gpt-image-1、dall-e-3）；按服务商支持的型号填写。: Model name (e.g. gpt-image-1, dall-e-3); use one supported by your provider.
只保存在插件数据里，不写日志、不写白板文件。: Stored only in plugin data; never logged or written to board files.
传给 images API 的 size（如 1024x1024）；不同模型支持: The size passed to the images API (e.g. 1024x1024); supported sizes vary by model — check your provider's docs.
保存即生效；脚本运行时弹窗会用它预填，仍可临时改一次。: Saved. Script prompts prefill with it; you can still override per run.
点一条立即对当前画布执行；先框选画布元素再跑 = 对选中操作（对齐、连线、标注类: Click a script to run it on the active board; select elements first for selection-based scripts, or open a document tab first for document-reading scripts. Use the trailing buttons to pin to the sidebar rail / edit script settings (right-click also pins). Scripts are Markdown files under {dir}, fully editable; add @excalidraw-onload to run on board open.
{n} 个内置脚本有新版本: {n} built-in script(s) have a new version
旧版内置脚本行为可能和插件不一致，重置会覆盖你在这些脚本里的修改（自建脚本不受影: Outdated built-in scripts may behave differently than the plugin expects. Resetting overwrites your edits to those scripts (your own scripts are untouched).
内置脚本已更新到最新版（{n} 个），你自建的脚本不受影响: Built-in scripts were updated to the latest version ({n}); your own scripts are untouched
从 excalidraw.com 的素材库网站复制链接，或选择本地 .excal: Copy a link from the excalidraw.com library site, or pick a local .excalidrawlib file.
粘贴「Add to Excalidraw」链接或 .excalidrawlib: Paste the "Add to Excalidraw" link or a .excalidrawlib URL
这个链接里的素材库地址无法识别，请重新复制: The library address in this link could not be recognized. Please copy it again.
无法识别的输入：请粘贴「Add to Excalidraw」跳转后地址栏里的链接: Unrecognized input: paste the URL from the address bar after "Add to Excalidraw", or the direct .excalidrawlib link from the "Download" button
仅桌面端支持在文件管理器中打开文件夹: Opening folders in the file manager is only available on the desktop app
无法读取所选文件: Could not read the selected file
从白板库挑一块，在当前画布中心插一张能点开的卡片: Pick a board from the library and drop a clickable card in the middle of the current canvas
已把路径换成白板卡片: Path converted into a board card
先打开一块白板，再往里插卡片: Open a whiteboard first, then insert the card into it
四条通道共用同一套计划 DSL 与风格包: All four channels share the same plan DSL and style packs
全关 = 白板退回纯手动模式；开关即时写入插件设置（内置智能体一栏需重载生效）: Turning everything off returns the whiteboard to pure manual mode; switches save to plugin settings instantly (the built-in agent row needs a reload)
列板 / 开板 / 按计划画图 / 生图插板，仅思源内置智能体可见: List / open boards, draw from a plan, generate and insert images — visible only to SiYuan's built-in agent
开关 = 注册门：关闭后不再注册四能力，需重载思源生效: Switch = registration gate: when off, the four capabilities are never registered; reload SiYuan to apply
WorkBuddy / Qoder 等外部智能体经 /mcp 调用，由 kern: External agents (WorkBuddy / Qoder…) call it through /mcp; registered by kernel.js
开关 = 调用门：工具仍在列表，调用被拒并回「通道已关闭」: Switch = call gate: tools stay listed, but calls are refused with 「channel closed」
能跑命令的智能体直接落盘 SVG，配 script/excali-draw/SK: Agents that can run commands write SVGs straight to disk; pairs with script/excali-draw/SKILL.md
开关 = 软门：CLI 落盘前读本设置，关闭后拒绝写入（读不拦）: Switch = soft gate: the CLI reads this setting before writing and refuses writes when off (reads are not blocked)
assets/excali-scripts/*.md + ea API，可让智能: assets/excali-scripts/*.md + the ea API; agents can write and run scripts on the spot
开关 = 入口门：关闭后 ☰、竖条、脚本库入口全部拒绝运行: Switch = entry gate: when off, the ☰, rail and script-library entries all refuse to run
内置智能体通道已开启：重载思源后注册生效: Built-in agent channel enabled — reload SiYuan for the capabilities to register
内置智能体通道已关闭：重载思源后彻底摘除: Built-in agent channel disabled — reload SiYuan to fully unregister
脚本通道已在「AI 通道」面板里关闭: The script channel is turned off in the AI Channels panel
把选中的图片描成可改色的原生笔画，可替换到画布或加入素材库: Trace the selected image into recolorable native strokes; replace it on the canvas or add it to the library
把画布里的画框当幻灯片，逐页放映；点图钉固定到画布右上角: Use canvas frames as slides and play them page by page; click the pin to keep the button at the top-right
拖动移动位置，双击复位: Drag to move; double-click to re-center
先在画布上框住一页内容，或点下方「＋ 新建页」按标准比例插一页。: Frame one block of content on the canvas, or use New slide below to insert a standard-ratio frame.
插到最后一页右侧，尺寸随现有页缩放: Placed to the right of the last slide, sized to match the deck
插入后可随时拖动、缩放，插入本身可撤销。: Drag or resize it any time afterwards; the insert itself is undoable.
拖动调整页序（聚焦后可用 ↑↓）: Drag to reorder slides (use ↑↓ once focused)
从当前这一页开始放映: Start presenting from the currently selected page
先画一个画框，再开始演示: Draw a frame before starting the presentation
把选中的图片描成一组原生笔画：可改描边色、可进素材库。只保留墨迹形状，不保留照片: Trace the selected image into native strokes: recolourable, library-ready. Keeps the ink shape only, not photo detail.
加入素材库失败：{msg}: Failed to add to the library: {msg}
已换成 {n} 笔可编辑笔画（⌘Z 撤销）: Replaced with {n} editable stroke(s) (⌘Z to undo)
没有识别到墨迹：请选择线条、毛笔或图标类图片（照片不适合描迹）。: No ink detected. Choose a line, brush or icon image (photos are not suitable for tracing).
这张图片没有内嵌数据，无法转换（请重新插入图片）。: This image has no embedded data and cannot be traced (please insert it again).
图片解码失败，无法转换。: Could not decode the image, so it cannot be traced.
图片已不在画布上: The image is no longer on the canvas
画布还没就绪: The canvas is not ready yet
请先选中一张图片，再使用这个动作: Select a single image before using this action
一次只能转换一张图片: Trace one image at a time
选中项不是图片: The selection is not an image
先打开一块白板，再转换图片: Open a whiteboard before tracing an image
按墨色浓淡分层填充整幅图：可改填充色、可缩放、可进素材库，还原度最高，适合毛笔字: Fill the whole image in ink-density layers: recolourable, scalable, library-ready. Highest fidelity — best for brush characters, icons and solid shapes.
已换成 {n} 层可编辑填充（⌘Z 撤销）: Replaced with {n} editable fill layer(s) (⌘Z to undo)
没有识别到墨迹：请选择透明底或纯色底的线条、毛笔或图标类图片（照片不适合转换）。: No ink detected. Choose a line, brush or icon image on a transparent or plain background (photos are not suitable).
折叠头里的成员已不在画布上：重新框选后再折叠: Members are no longer on canvas: reselect and fold again
已解散这个折叠：成员已回到画布: Fold dissolved: members are back on canvas
先选中要并入这个折叠的元素（Shift 多选）: Select the elements to add first (Shift for multi-select)
这个折叠里还没有成员: This fold has no members yet
先选中要移出这个折叠的成员: Select the members to remove first
把镜头开过去看这一页: Fly the camera to this slide
已按箭头连页：放映沿箭头走，可分叉也能绕回。: Slides are linked by arrows: playback follows them, with branches and loops.
部分页面还没连上箭头，没连的按页序继续放。: Some slides are not linked yet; unlinked ones play in order.
每页停留 10 秒后自动翻页: Advance automatically after 10 seconds per slide
拖入的不是文档或块，已忽略: Not a SiYuan document or block; ignored
已插入 {n} 个思源链接，单击打开对应文档: Inserted {n} SiYuan link(s); click to open the document
无法识别的文档链接：{link}。支持思源块超链接（siyuan://block: Unrecognized document link: {link}. Supported: block link (siyuan://blocks/…), doc link (siyuan://doc/…), block ref ((id 'title'))
已识别：{what}，确认后点链接即可跳转: Recognized: {what}. Confirm, then click the link to jump.
这个链接格式认不出。支持：块超链接 siyuan://blocks/…、文档超链: Unrecognized link format. Supported: block link siyuan://blocks/…, doc link siyuan://doc/…, block ref ((id 'title'))
请粘贴思源链接（块超链接或块引用），或用下面的搜索找一篇文档: Paste a SiYuan link (block link or block ref), or search for a document below
这个元素没有思源链接可复制: This element has no SiYuan link to copy
复制失败：浏览器拒绝了剪贴板访问: Copy failed: the browser denied clipboard access
这个折叠里没有可收起的成员: This fold has no member to fold
展开失败：成员可能已被删除: Unfold failed: members may have been deleted
每一次更新优化了什么、解决了什么问题，都记在这里。: Every improvement and fix in each release is recorded here.
← → 翻页 · 空格 下一步 · F 全屏 · Esc 退出: ← → navigate · Space next · F fullscreen · Esc exit
← → 翻页 · 空格 下一步 · P 暂停 · F 全屏 · Esc 退出: ← → navigate · Space next · P pause · F fullscreen · Esc exit
固定后出现在画布右缘: Pinned actions show on the right edge
使用说明 · 先框选再跑，或先打开文档页签: How to use · Select elements or open a doc tab first
编排这一页里每条怎么出场: Choose how each item on this page enters
这一页还没有可编排的内容：先在画框里放点东西。: Nothing to arrange on this page yet — put something inside the frame first.
淡入并微微上移，最克制。: Fades in with a slight lift — the subtlest option.
带一点过冲再定住，最醒目。: Overshoots slightly, then settles — the boldest option.
从下方升上来，位移更大。: Rises from below with a larger travel.
从左滑入，适合箭头和连线。: Slides in from the left — good for arrows and lines.
顺着它自己的形状擦出来，适合高亮、笔刷这类填充图形。: Sweeps open along its own shape — good for highlights and brush fills.
跟着元素类型走：文本浮现、图形弹入、图片升起、箭头滑入。: Follows the element type: text fades, shapes pop, images rise, arrows slide.
本页：在画面里点元素编排: Page: click elements on the preview to choreograph
页单：翻页、排序、入片: Pages: browse, reorder, include or exclude
点画面里的元素选中它；右键直接换效果。: Click an element on the preview to select it; right-click to change its effect.
这里是画框空白处，点带编号的元素。: This is empty frame space — click a numbered element.
整页一起出：画面只做预览，逐条设定暂不生效。: Whole page at once: the preview is view-only and per-item settings are paused.
点画面或列表选中一条；点效果换动作；步号相同的一起出。: Click the preview or list to select; click the effect to change it; same step numbers enter together.
画框里的每个文字、图形、图片、箭头都算一条。: Every text, shape, image and arrow inside the frame is one item.
成组元素一起出场；附着在图形上的文字跟着图形走。: Grouped elements enter together; text attached to a shape follows that shape.
编号和下面这一行一一对应，点任意一边都会选中同一条。: Numbers match the rows below — clicking either side selects the same item.
画框本身和画框外的元素不参与编排。: The frame itself and elements outside it are not choreographed.
让 Agent 会画 · 会参照风格: Lets agents draw and follow a style
复制提示词发给 Agent —— 它会按路径读技能，再动手画: Copy the prompt and send it to your agent — it reads the skill by path, then draws
贴一次，之后每个新会话自动知道去哪儿读: Paste once; every new session then knows where to read
不用读文件，直接当参数传: No file to read — pass it as a parameter
黑白粗线 · 网点感 · 强调色一块: Bold black lines · screentone · one accent block
马克笔色块 · 圆头线 · 手写感: Marker blocks · round caps · handwritten feel
本机有命令行：提示词会带上 scripts/excali-board.mjs，并: CLI available: the prompt mentions scripts/excali-board.mjs and still prefers built-in tools.
本机没有命令行（集市安装版）：提示词改用内置工具或内核 MCP，并跳过 SKIL: No CLI (marketplace build): the prompt switches to built-in tools or kernel MCP and skips the command steps in SKILL.md.
风格包目录读取失败：{msg}: Failed to read the style pack folder: {msg}
就在插件里，随插件升级；Agent 靠它知道有哪些工具、怎么排: Lives in the plugin and upgrades with it; it tells the agent which tools exist and how to lay things out
配色 / 线宽 / 字号 / 留白，只在「统一风格、批量出图」时读: Colors / stroke width / font size / spacing — read only when unifying style or batch drawing
装一次，Qoder / Cursor / 思源的新会话都会自动发现它: Install once; new sessions in Qoder / Cursor / SiYuan all find it automatically
贴进仓库根目录的 AGENTS.md: Paste into AGENTS.md at the repo root
只对这个仓库生效的一行指针，贴一次即可: A one-line pointer scoped to this repo — paste it once
已画好的白板不受影响: Boards you already drew are unaffected
请填一个 http(s) 链接，或改成粘贴 JSON: Enter an http(s) link, or switch to Paste JSON
效果图没下下来（不影响安装；可之后把同名 PNG 放进 previews/）: Preview download failed (install still works; you can drop a same-named PNG into previews/ later)
效果图写的是相对路径，链接通道拿不到（不影响安装）: The preview is a relative path the URL channel can't fetch (install still works)
粘贴模式拿不到相对路径的图；装好后把同名 PNG 放进 previews/ 即可: Paste mode can't fetch relative images; after installing, drop a same-named PNG into previews/ to show it
这个 JSON 没带同目录的效果图（不影响安装）: This JSON has no preview image next to it (install still works)
列表读的是 data/assets/excali-styles/；没装就没有文件: This list reads data/assets/excali-styles/. Nothing installed means no file, so no invocation is offered.
还没有任何风格包：插件自带的包会出现在这里，点「安装」即可。: No style packs yet. Bundled packs show up here — just click Install.
未安装时只看不复制，避免给 Agent 一个不存在的路径。: Before installing you can only view — no nonexistent path for the agent.
效果图是本地绝对路径，不依赖网络。: The preview is a local absolute path — no network needed.
安装后「效果图」按钮才会复制本地路径。: Preview copies the local path only after installing.
只删文件，不动已经画好的白板: Deletes files only — existing boards stay intact
移除后再让 Agent 传 {name} 会报「风格不存在」；已经画好的白板不受: After removal, passing {name} reports style not found; existing boards are unaffected.
内置包随时可以重新安装。: Bundled packs can be reinstalled at any time.
文件删掉就没了，需要重新导入。: A deleted file is gone for good — import it again.
确认后写入插件目录: Confirm to write into the plugin folder
已有同名包 {name}，写入会覆盖它的样式文件。: A pack named {name} already exists; writing overwrites its style file.
写入后立即生效——每次画图前插件都会重读这个目录。: Takes effect immediately — the plugin re-reads this folder before every drawing.
仓库根目录放 excali-style.json（+ preview.png）即: Put excali-style.json (+ preview.png) at the repo root; GitHub page links are auto-converted to raw URLs
国内网络经常打不开 raw：失败就换「粘贴 JSON」或「让 Agent 代装」: raw is often unreachable on networks in China: if it fails, switch to Paste JSON or Let an agent install.
校验规则与加载器一致：name 小写、extends 必须存在、颜色 #rrgg: Same rules as the loader: lowercase name, extends must exist, #rrggbb colors, preview must not contain a path.
只在本机读取，不上传；桌面端会顺带读同目录的效果图: Read locally only, never uploaded; on desktop the sibling preview is read too
选好后会用同一套规则校验，再显示要写入的绝对路径。: It is validated with the same rules, then you see the absolute path to be written.
网络打不开 raw 时：外部 Agent（Qoder / Cursor）有自己的: When raw is unreachable: external agents (Qoder / Cursor) have file access and can write directly. Send them the text below.
思源内置智能体没有文件写入工具，走不通这条路——请改用「粘贴 JSON」。: SiYuan's built-in agent has no file-write tool, so this path won't work — use Paste JSON instead.
一份 JSON + 一张效果图: One JSON file + one preview image
只写两个文件：包 JSON + 效果图；不动其他包。: Writes only two files: pack JSON + preview; other packs are untouched.
按阅读顺序，排在编过步的之后: Reading order, after the numbered steps
这一页所有内容一起出现: Everything on this page appears together
点效果改这一条怎么出；步号相同的一起出，留空排在后面。: Click an effect to set how this item enters; same step numbers enter together, blank goes last.
整页一起出；逐条设定暂不生效。: The whole page appears at once; per-item settings are inactive.
切回「逐条」后，下面每条的步号与效果会恢复生效。: Switch back to "Step by step" to make the steps and effects below take effect again.
步号升序；未编步的排最后、按阅读顺序: By step number; unnumbered items go last in reading order
整页一起出，顺序与步号暂不生效: Whole page appears at once; order and step numbers are inactive
这一页还没有可编排的内容: Nothing to choreograph on this page yet
先在画框里放点东西，再回来排顺序。: Put something inside the frame first, then come back to order it.
步号相同的一起出（自动错开 70ms）；留空 = 排在编过步的之后。: Same step numbers enter together (staggered by 70 ms); blank = after the numbered steps.
拖动缩略图左上角把手改页序；双击页名改名；眼睛管放不放。: Drag the handle at a thumbnail's top-left to reorder; double-click a name to rename; the eye includes or excludes the page.
画面只做预览：改位置或文字请回画布；翻页点上方 ‹ ›。: The stage is a preview: edit position or text on the canvas; use ‹ › above to change pages.
两栏：缩略图更大，看清页内细节: 2 columns: larger thumbnails, easier to see details
